app_info.subtitle: Find contract tech jobs
app_info.description: RadarJobs connects to a user's existing account to search current contract technology opportunities, inspect one selected job, and review existing personalized recommendations. Search accepts ordinary role wording and returns presentation-ready results with the actual source posting and RadarJobs detail links.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing RadarJobs inventory but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries bounded RadarJobs inventory and returns the stored provider source-posting URL plus the fixed-origin RadarJobs detail URL for each match.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter jobs, submit applications, send messages, or change subscriptions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the account's existing recommendation set but records bounded operational usage telemetry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses recommendations already held within the authenticated RadarJobs account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not generate recommendations, upload a resume, change profile data, or modify access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one eligible opportunity but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads one bounded RadarJobs record and returns its stored provider source-posting URL plus the fixed-origin RadarJobs detail URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not save, apply to, update, or remove the selected job.

test_cases.description: Search directly for a bounded set of current contract jobs with explicit requirements.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find five current remote data engineering contracts in the United States that allow 1099 and pay at least $50 per hour.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls search directly without readiness or taxonomy preflights and returns up to five current matches with authoritative contract classification, pay, source posting links, and RadarJobs detail links.

test_cases.description: Read the connected account's complete existing personalized recommendations.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my complete current RadarJobs recommendations in ranked order.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the existing ranked personalized recommendation set without starting new processing or calling search, taxonomy, account-state, or per-result detail tools.

test_cases.description: Inspect one eligible job returned by RadarJobs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me more about the first RadarJobs result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current bounded detail for the selected opportunity with supporting evidence, the actual source-posting URL, and the RadarJobs detail URL.

test_cases.description: Search using ordinary role wording without requiring taxonomy language.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find remote AI engineer contract work that allows C2C.
test_cases.expected_output: Passes the ordinary role wording directly to search, preserves the C2C and remote constraints, and presents the returned classifications without editorial re-validation.

test_cases.description: Return a complete zero-result answer without retrying or silently relaxing filters.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find current remote quantum COBOL compiler contracts paying at least $900 per hour.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls search once, reports the complete exact-match result, and asks which one constraint the user wants to broaden without invoking a retired or follow-up tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs for permanent non-technology employment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a permanent registered nurse position.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because this request is outside contract technology work.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs to edit a resume.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite the experience section of my resume.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because it does not edit or process resumes through this plugin.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs for purchases or job applications.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy a RadarJobs subscription and apply to the first job for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because the plugin cannot purchase access, change subscriptions, or submit job applications.
